item.title: Overgrown hedge and grass/weeds growing over the kerb along A46 between Up Hatherley Way and Leckhampton Lane, 6th November
item.description:
I live on the Shurdington Road and I wish to complain about the state of the hedge and grass verge on the eastern side of the A46 in this location. The side of the hedge has not been trimmed and the grass/weeds have now significantly overgrown over the kerb. In past years the grass/weeds have been cut once a year, but it has never been done properly in the 6 years we have been here. When the grass/weeds are cut the machinery does not cut the grass/weeds that have grown over the kerb onto the tarmac. Moreover, when the road sweeper cleans the side of the road it does not remove the grass/weeds that have grown over the kerb. To make it matters worse the side of the hedge facing the road has not been trimmed nor has the grass verge been cut this year. This side of the road is now looking totally unkept and a total mess and the hedge and grass verge needs to be cut/trimmed properly along this stretch of road so that the grass/weeds are not overgrowing over the kerb onto the road.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Shurdington Road, Shurdington, Tewkesbury
